subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` as the supported opt-in bound for deferred context-engine turn maintenance, with late maintenance side effects fenced after timeout?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but adding a config surface and defining the post-timeout session-state contract are maintainer product/API choices rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
options.body: Merge this shape after owner review because it preserves default behavior while giving operators a documented bound for wedged background maintenance.

options.title: Keep the timeout internal
options.body: Ask the author to remove the public config surface and choose a fixed core-owned timeout if maintainers do not want another operator knob.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery policy
options.body: Hold this PR behind the wider stuck-session recovery design if maintainers want one policy for maintenance, embedded runs, and queued-message abort behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
recommendation.body: Merge this shape after owner review because it preserves default behavior while giving operators a documented bound for wedged background maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman reviewed/merged the original background turn-maintenance feature and is the strongest available owner signal for the API and session-state policy question.
